summaries: A Form 10-K Annual Report for AquaBounty Technologies, Inc. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2021. Relevant to the task: The document provides Consolidated Balance Sheets and Statements of Changes in Stockholders’ Equity reporting Total Stockholders’ Equity of $213.8 million as of December 31, 2021 (compared to $114.9 million in 2020). This establishes the equity baseline immediately prior to the 2022 period requested in the task. However, the filing covers only the 2021 fiscal year and does not include financial data for 2022, 2023, or 2024, so it cannot independently demonstrate the changes over the requested three-year span.

A Form 10-K Annual Report for AquaBounty Technologies, Inc. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2022. Relevant to the task: It contains Consolidated Balance Sheets and Statements of Changes in Stockholders’ Equity, reporting Total Stockholders’ Equity of $191,921,043 at December 31, 2022, and $213,802,763 at December 31, 2021. The document does not include financial data for 2023 or 2024, as it covers the period ending in 2022 only.

A Form 10-K Annual Report for AquaBounty Technologies, Inc. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023. Relevant to the task: The document reports Total Stockholders’ Equity (equivalent to Owners’ Equity) of $165.0 million as of December 31, 2023, and provides comparative data showing $191.9 million as of December 31, 2022. It details the net loss of $27.6 million and share-based compensation driving the equity changes within the Consolidated Statements of Changes in Stockholders’ Equity. However, this filing covers the period ending in 2023 and does not contain financial data for 2024, preventing a complete analysis of the requested three-year period without additional documents.
